recommendation: Keep the FHIR core audit commit as-is. If the remaining 'thoe' typo is still present in the live THO CodeSystem, pursue that as a THO/UTG technical correction rather than a FHIR core source change.
issue_request: FHIR-36707 is an Applied/Persuasive CBCC FHIR-core Consent change request asking to remove embedded references, notes, and comments from Consent Category Code definitions and make small wording updates for advance directive and health care directive definitions. Its resolution states that the work was pending on UP-413.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR core commit for FHIR-36707 or UP-413 was found. The current active Consent category ValueSet in core composes http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/consentcategorycodes, and commit 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 had already removed source/consent/codesystem-consent-category.xml as part of moving UTG content out of core.
additional_context: UP-413 is Proposal Implemented and explicitly relates to FHIR-36707, with change objects including the THO consentcategorycodes CodeSystem. Terminology Infrastructure minutes recorded review of UP-413, and THO 5.4.0 release notes list UP-413 as published. A current THO fetch shows the requested definition cleanup, though the health care directive definition still contains the typo 'thoe' noted in a 2024 UP-413 comment for technical correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR core source was changed because the authoritative Consent Category Code definitions are external THO content; changing the core ValueSet would not fix the CodeSystem definitions and would duplicate terminology ownership.
